messages.subject: brew code ignored?
parts:
I am setting up RApache on this Ubuntu server in Amazon cloud.
Everything seems fine except that after I changed the httpd.conf file
to add the above entries, the brew file and test.r file does not run
those r code, simply print the source file out in the browser. Any
idea what I may have missed? I did checked the loaded modules in
Apache, mod_R.so is indeeded loaded in apache. The RApacheInfo page
also can not be found.

btw, I did remember to restart apache everytime I modify something in
httpd.conf, and I am quite positive it is the right httpd.conf file I
should be modifying, since if I made a typo in that httpd.conf file, I
can not restart apache

here is what I put into httpd.conf

LoadModule R_module /etc/httpd/modules/mod_R.so

ROutputErrors

<Location /RApacheInfo>
SetHandler r-info
</Location>

<Directory /var/www/html/rscripts>
SetHandler r-script
RHandler sys.source
</Directory>

<Directory /var/www/html/brew>
SetHandler r-script
RHandler brew::brew
</Directory>


But why is it not working?

messages.author: 25a4f5811cd7d59e
messages.subject: Re: brew code ignored?
parts:
A situation like this is difficult to debug. Have you scoped out the
error log? Also, are you sure you're running an Ubuntu Ec2 instance?
Ubuntu typically installs its modules in /usr/lib/apache2/modules and
the config files are located in /etc/apache2.

Jeff
